# Vibhor Mishra

> AI Systems Engineer building multi-agent orchestration systems, LLM-powered backends, and Agentic AI pipelines. Focus on agent coordination protocols, RAG architectures, and production-grade distributed systems.

Portfolio site for Vibhor Mishra — a Computer Science undergraduate at SIRT Bhopal working on agentic AI, multi-agent systems, and applied ML. The site documents projects (VEDA, MARG, IRIS, DHARA, Kachra Seth), research interests, engineering skills, experience, and writing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, mission, timeline, highlight projects, skills graph, experience, and GitHub activity.
- [Projects](/projects): AI systems, software products, and research prototypes with case studies.
- [Blog](/blog): Notes on agentic AI, backend systems, and engineering practice.

## Projects

- [VEDA](/projects/veda): Multi-agent AI career simulation platform.
- [MARG](/projects/marg): Neurosymbolic multi-agent crisis response system (Google Solution Challenge 2026).
- [IRIS](/projects/iris): AI systems project.
- [DHARA](/projects/dhara): Smart India Hackathon environmental project.

## Blog

- [Kachra Seth — Building an AI-Powered Urban Waste Ecosystem](/blog/kachra-seth): 3-layer SaaS platform with DenseNet201 waste classification and route optimization.
- [What is Agentic AI?](/blog/what-is-agentic-ai): A technical overview for developers on the transition from LLMs to autonomous agentic systems.
